label: sec:mass-endomorphism-opener-intro
html:
With the knot–particle dictionary (Knots, Particles, and Confinement) and its Eightfold Way multiplet structure (The Eightfold Way and Flavor Structure) established, this chapter develops the algebraic engine that extracts a numerical mass invariant from each particle's closed braid. Three distinct mathematical objects participate in this construction (notation-collisions):

  1. The mass endomorphism \mathcal{M}(K) \in \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(X_K), a categorical morphism X_K \to X_K on the Reshetikhin–Turaev long-knot object X_K.
  2. The Hecke mass element \Phi_{\mathrm{mass}}(\beta) \in H_n(R, q), the braid-group image of \mathcal{M}(K) inside the Iwahori–Hecke algebra, acting on V^{\otimes n} by quantum Schur–Weyl duality.
  3. The categorical mass functional \mathfrak{m}(\varrho) = |\mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta))| \cdot \mathrm{VolDensity}(K, q_0), the scalar obtained by closing \Phi_{\mathrm{mass}}(\beta) under the Jones–Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M and pairing it with the hyperbolic volume density.

This opening section states the mass endomorphism conjecture and identifies the six-term unified mass formula with the E_\infty page of the Gröbner–Shirshov spectral sequence. Subsequent sections evaluate the Markov trace across Wedderburn blocks at z = q^3/(q^2+1) (the eigenspace section and the Markov-trace section), introduce the complex volume \mathfrak{V} (the complex-volume section), derive the per-irrep \chi-character closed forms (the u-coordinate section, the cyclotomic \chi-character section, and the \Delta\mathrm{tr}_M section), and close with the Hecke–Baer-* chirality pairing (the Baer-star section).
